name: silo-task-control
description: A fast, focused control panel for finding, reviewing, and dispatching Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Control Codex tasks from one panel.
interface.longDescription: SILO opens instantly, syncs Codex-native running state, classifies unfinished and completed work, and analyzes the latest two turns to smart-select tasks that should continue or receive a quality pass. Users can switch between a Codex-native panel and an external window, review editable Continue or Optimize prompts, confirm that dispatch messages are visible in Codex, and follow live progress in the right-side activity rail.
defaultPrompt: 打开 SILO 控制面板，扫描我现在的 Codex 任务。
打开 SILO 外置面板。
列出所有可继续的任务，并让我选择继续或优化。
使用 SILO 智能选择，推荐应该继续或优化的任务。
检查最近的 Codex 任务状态，不要启动任何任务。
